FloatingBox variants
|-- Shared display contracts
|   |-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|   |-- DisplayState: rootIds: string[]; nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane>
|   |-- DisplayNodeBase extends DisplayGeometry; childIds, expansion, geometryPolicy
|   `-- Geometry uses unscaled pixels in canvas or viewport coordinates
|-- FloatingPane alternatives
|   |-- SelectionRegion: kind='selection'; sourceBoxId, sourceContentId, sourceAscii, rect
|   |   |-- sourceRevisionId?, selectedIds, displayMode, activeChildId? [fields]
|   |   `-- Captures panel context; SelectionState manages membership separately
|   |-- ProjectedPane: kind='projection'; title, revision references, content
|   |   |-- content.kind: 'call-tree' | 'compaction' | 'source-code' | 'code-panel'
|   |   `-- Saved scroll is a checkpoint; SourcePaneViewState manages live scroll
|   |-- ConversationPane: kind='conversation'; thread, draft, presentation, canvasAnchor
|   |   `-- The semantic bubble anchor is independent of the panel presentation
|   `-- DetailPane: kind='detail'; title, ascii, sectionId?
|-- Display tree operations
|   |-- addDisplayNode(state, node, ownerId?); removeDisplayNode(state, id)
|   |-- Adding links a child or root; removal recursively prunes descendants
|   |-- setExpansion(state, id, expansion); updateDisplayGeometry(state, id, geometry)
|   |-- Collapsing saves expanded geometry for later restoration
|   |-- measureDisplayNode(state, id, width, height)
|   `-- visibleProjectionIds chooses active stacked projections or chained descendants
`-- Derived arrow variant
    |-- document.edges -> drawEdge(...) -> FloatingBoxArrow [data/call sketch]
    `-- Arrows follow connection anchors and are absent from persisted DisplayState
